beats.text: Five classic books that are genuinely, laugh-out-loud funny.
One. Don Quixote — Cervantes. A man so deep in novels he mistakes windmills for giants. The first great comic novel.
Two. Three Men in a Boat — Jerome. A lazy river holiday turns into pure Victorian farce.
Three. The Importance of Being Earnest — Wilde. The wittiest play in English, line after line.
Four. The Canterbury Tales — Chaucer. Medieval pilgrims telling rude, brilliant, very funny stories.
Five. Candide — Voltaire. A savage, gleeful comedy about how absurd the world really is.
The classics aren't all solemn. Some are centuries-old comedy gold. Full retellings on the channel.
